jobDescription:
Senior Data Analyst — Riyadh

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to support our expansion in the Saudi market.

Requirements:
• 3+ years of experience in data analysis and business intelligence
• Proficiency in SQL and Python
• Experience with Power BI or Tableau
• Strong communication skills in English and Arabic
• Experience working with government or large enterprise datasets
• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain dashboards for stakeholders
• Automate reporting workflows
• Provide data-driven insights to support strategic decisions
